Section B: Description of the Supplies/Services Required To maintain nighttime and inclement weather flying during upcoming runway construction, a Precision Approach Path Indicator (PAPI) emergency lighting system is required. A PAPI system is an unattended visual aid that guides pilots onto the correct landing approach path by indicating their position on the glide path.

Section C: Justification for Soliciting from a Single Source or Brand Name The upcoming Runway 33 threshold displacement beginning on 28 October 2025, necessitates an immediate replacement of the existing PAPI system. The current PAPI system will no longer align with the new threshold, creating a critical safety hazard that would prevent continued flying operations on Runway 33. To mitigate any interruptions to the flying mission and ensure flight safety, the new PAPI system will need to be installed as soon as possible. The Avlite PAPI system sold by SPX Aids to Navigation, LLC is immediately available and meets all required specifications for rapid installation and operational readiness, making it the only viable option to avoid a complete shutdown of Runway 33 operations during inclement weather and nighttime.

Section D: Efforts to Obtain Competition An immediate need for a PAPI replacement kit necessitates selecting a vendor who can meet a critical delivery timeline. Research indicates that only Avlite, by SPX Aids to Navigation can meet this critical need. Flight Light, Airport Lighting Company, Airfield Lighting Systems, and Genesis Lamp all quoted assembly and shipping times of 8 - 12 weeks. SPX Aids to Navigation LLC has an Avlite PAPI system assembled and ready for shipment, estimating a 2 - 3 week delivery window. Reinforcing Avlite's ability to meet the demanding timeline, the 635 Material Maintenance Group (the Air Force's only organic basic expeditionary airfield resources unit) at Holloman AFB identifies Avlite as their primary source for emergency airfield lighting requirements.

Section E: Steps to Preclude Future Single Source or Brand Name Awards This acquisition of an emergency PAPI system is a one-time requirement driven by an emerging and unforeseen need. To prevent similar sole-source situations in the future, OSS and CE will document the specific factors that contributed to the unanticipated need for this item, including the circumstances that led to this situation, specific challenges encountered, and the rationale for selecting Avlite.

Section F: Contracting Officer's Determination I have determined, in accordance with FAR 13.106-1(b)(1), that the circumstances of this contract action deem only a single source is reasonably available.
